frontier.hypothesis: A directed permuter over the tail RA structure finds a pure-C form that keeps the single-temp interleave AND steers the shared load-temp to v0 (mask to v1).
frontier.mechanism: Random+directed PERM mutation of the 3-load + const-store tail against a clean single-function target exposes RA-steering structures manual analysis misses; base from the floor-9 pure-swap form (only RA differs).

frontier.hypothesis: Some structure makes the shared 3-load temp a LOCAL contiguous quantity (or makes mask GLOBAL), letting the load-temp win v0 while staying a single reused register.
frontier.mechanism: The local/global split is decided by whether a pseudo's sets combine into one contiguous quantity; the load-temp's 3 disjoint loads currently force it global. A structure that chains them (without a dead/cheat computation) would make it local and born-first.
frontier.next_probe: Investigate whether any legitimate pure-C flow chains the three loads into one live range that preserves the interleave; if none exists without a dead store, this axis is dead and only the permuter remains.
